Devices Dealers Blog About Studios OnomatoPedal Merch EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Menu EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Devices Dealers Blog About Studios OnomatoPedal Merch Speaker Cranker Discrete, all-analog distortion enhancement device (i.e. not a booster) THIS DEVICE IS NO LONGER IN PRODUCTION   Speaker Cranker™ Overdrive The Speaker Cranker™ is a discrete, all-analog distortion enhancement device (i.e., not a booster), designed to give your signal some extra grit and a slight boost without drastically altering your tone. Think of it as sticking an extra preamp tube in your amplifier for more overdrive. Single notes will blossom and bloom with rich harmonics and responsive, tube-like sag. Power chords will sound thicker and crunchier, a little more ragged around the edges. Complex chords will remain distinct and complex, as the Speaker Cranker is designed to preserve your tone’s integrity without muddying up the low-end, or “rounding out” the mids, or adding any top-end “shimmer,” or “sparkle,” or any of that other garbage. It’s your tone. Cranked. Ya got that? Repeat after me: “The Speaker Cranker is an overdrive, not a boost.” View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize Controls     More: Controls the amount of dirt. Audio Samples GUITAR SAMPLES Crank It Up Gibson Les Paul Full Dial Sweep Gibson Les Paul Warm Front End Fender Telecaster Half then Full Fender Telecaster DRUM SAMPLES Drum Dirt Stereo Bus V1 / No Bass Stereo Bus V2 / No Bass Stereo Bus   View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize View fullsize Suggested Settings Dirt Road Dust Add some open air and dirt to your go to amp gainstage. It’s Just Better Your already great amp just got better. Six String Salute Makes all those full chords thrust wide open.   Tech Specs Dimensions: 4.75 x 2.50 x 2.25 in. (121 x 64 x 57 mm) with knobs Current Draw: 10 mA Input Impedance: 2.2 MΩ Output Impedance: <10 kΩ Switching This device is true bypass and uses electronic relay-based switching. Audio will not pass without power. Power This device can be powered by a 9v battery or a standard 9-volt DC power supply with a 2.1mm negative center barrel. We always recommend pedal-specific, transformer-isolated wall-wart power supplies or multiple isolated-output supplies. Pedals will make extra noise if there is ripple or unclean power. Switching-type power supplies, daisy chains and non-pedal specific power supplies do not filter dirty power as well and let through unwanted noise. DO NOT RUN AT HIGHER VOLTAGES!
